object.name: evi_blitwaves
object.digest: No aliasing BLIT oscillators with a choice of simultaneous wave shapes outputs
object.description: No aliasing classic synth wave shapes, DSF-BLIT-like algorithm, sweep/modulation works with no noise, and cheap. Good for subtractive synthesis because we stay very bright right up to nyquist, but no hard sync.

inlets.name: pulse
inlets.digest: PWM 0..1 for wave shapes that use it (RECT, TRI and Train)

outlets.name: sine
outlets.digest: Analog Sine wave oscillator with harmonics, output if @addsine attribute set to on.

outlets.name: train
outlets.digest: Naive Train (rectified naive square) wave oscillator, output if @addtrain attribute set to on.

outlets.name: sync
outlets.digest: Global phase sync output 0..1, output if @addsync attribute set to on.

attributes.name: addsine
attributes.description: 0 = SINE off (default, no CPU used), 1 = SINE on out of outlet 4

attributes.name: addsync
attributes.description: 0 = off, 1 (default) = main phase output out of outlet 6, 2 = pwm phase output out of outlet 6

attributes.name: addtrain
attributes.description: 0 = off (default, no CPU used), 1 = train based on main phase out of outlet 5, 2 = train based on pwm phase out of outlet 5

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Internal parameters smoothed by this time in ms. Turn off (0) for audio rate modulation of inlets 1 and 2
